ops.title: Cleanup quiet-root config must preserve whitespace inside each value
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali. Next step: preserve git config value boundaries instead of splitting on all whitespace. Evidence at 60eefaf1b: cleanup_caps.go:44 uses strings.Fields on cleanupGlobalConfig output from cleanup_darwin.go:78; a valid value such as /Users/yasyf/Quiet Trees becomes two roots, and Trees is rejected as relative. Daemon startup then fails at cleanup_darwin.go:108-110. Source-only review; no tests ran.

ops.text: A single configured directory containing spaces or tabs remains one quiet root and daemon startup succeeds.
Multiple configured values remain separate roots and relative values still fail explicitly.
